items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: And it's signed by A. A. Betts, vice-president.

ctx.x: Saying that this will confirm that Turner Musical Instruments, Limited has presented Mr. Herman Autrey with a new instrument, Olds R-10 Recording Trumpet 579992 in return for his artist's endorsement of our product. Mr. Autrey has provided us with a signed publicity and promotional release which allows us to use his picture and endorsement in our advertising. And it's signed by A. A. Betts, vice-president.
